Find the solutions **in degrees** to the equation $2\operatorname{tan}⁡x-2\sqrt{3}=0$ for ${0}^{∘}\le x<{360}^{∘}.$

**In ascending order,** the solutions are $x=$
{{field-1}}${}^{∘}$ and $x=$

feedback.worked_solution:
First, we rearrange the equation and isolate $\operatorname{tan}⁡x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}2\operatorname{tan}⁡x-2\sqrt{3} & =0 \\ 2\operatorname{tan}⁡x & =2\sqrt{3} \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡x & =\sqrt{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we find the principal value:

$$
x=arctan\,(\sqrt{3})={60}^{∘}
$$

Since ${60}^{∘}$ lies inside the given domain, our first solution is ${x}_{1}={60}^{∘}.$

To generate more solutions, we add integer multiples of ${180}^{∘}.$ Hence,

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & ={180}^{∘}+{x}_{1} \\  & ={180}^{∘}+{60}^{∘} \\  & ={240}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, in ascending order, the solutions are $x=60\,{\,}^{∘}$ and $x=240\,{\,}^{∘}.$
